v9-3.candidate: The Lord said to him, “I have heard the voice of your prayer and supplication which you made before Me. I have done for you according to your whole prayer. I have consecrated this house you built, to put My name there for ever; My eyes shall be there and My heart always.

v10-7.candidate: I did not believe those speaking to me until I arrived and my eyes saw. Behold, what they reported to me is not half of it! You have added good things beyond them, beyond every report I heard in my land.
v10-7.close: I did not believe those speaking to me until I arrived and my eyes saw. Behold, it is not half as they reported to me! You have added good things beyond them, beyond every report I heard in my land.
